name: synthetos-run
description: run.synthetos.com: browser workspace for configuring and running Synthetos CNC controllers.

scripts.deps: depcruise packages apps workers tools --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs && node tools/gates/src/source/cli.ts
scripts.gates: pnpm lint && pnpm deps && pnpm licence && pnpm ci-policy
scripts.bench:check: node tools/gates/src/bundle/cli.ts --target bench apps/web/dist-bench && node tools/gates/src/artifact/bench-cli.ts apps/web/dist apps/web/dist-bench
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm gates && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm scan && pnpm build:fake-serial && pnpm fake-serial:diff && pnpm build:bench && pnpm bench:check
scripts.ci-policy: node tools/gates/src/workflow/cli.ts && node tools/gates/src/codeowners/cli.ts && node tools/gates/src/review/template-cli.ts && node tools/gates/src/bindings/cli.ts
scripts.e2e:bench: pnpm build && pnpm build:bench && pnpm bench:check && pnpm --filter @synthetos/e2e e2e:bench
scripts.e2e:fake-serial: pnpm build && pnpm build:fake-serial && pnpm fake-serial:diff && pnpm --filter @synthetos/e2e e2e:fake-serial
